entries.title: Día de los Muertos Kids' Grab & Go Mask Craft Kits
entries.description: Stop by to pick up a free Day of the Dead Paper Mask Craft Kit, filled with colorful craft pieces and supplies for children to decorate their own Calavera (sugar skull) mask.\nFirst come, first served.

entries.title: Evergreen Branch Library's 20th Anniversary Celebration
entries.description:
Evergreen Branch is home to Discoveries,nbsp;a public artwork by Larry Kirkland featuring three white marble sculptures of an ear, mouth, and eye that celebrate learning and discovery through our senses.nbsp;Stop by and check it out during your next visit.
Special Thanks
This event has been generously sponsored by the San José Public Library Foundation, Friends of the Evergreen Branch Library, and Friends of the West Valley Branch Library.
entries.priorTitleZh: Evergreen 分馆 20 周年庆典
entries.priorDescriptionZh: Evergreen 分馆设有 Larry Kirkland 创作的公共艺术作品 Discoveries，由三座白色大理石雕塑组成，分别表现耳朵、嘴巴和眼睛，展现通过感官学习和发现的主题。欢迎到访欣赏。活动获得 San José Public Library Foundation、Friends of the Evergreen Branch Library 和 Friends of the West Valley Branch Library 赞助。

entries.title: INSIDERS: Activities at the Village Square Branch
entries.description: Join us for socializing, finding new friends, networking, making jokes, learn to play Dungeons Dragons, and having fun with art!

entries.description: Infant and Toddler Storytime invites children and their caregivers to wiggle, rhyme, and sing with diverse books, songs, and fingerplays that encourage language, play, and exploration. \nThis program is geared for children 0 to 3 years of age and their parents/caregivers, but all children are welcome!

entries.title: Baby Lapsit Storytime + Stay & Play
entries.description: This program is for babies that are not yet walking confidently, and their caregivers.nbsp;\nBaby Lapsit invites newborns, infants, babies, and their caregivers to learn together and strengthen their relationship with each other through stories, songs, bounces, tickles, rhymes, books, and play.\nAfter Storytime concludes, we invite you to Stay Play!

entries.title: Bilingual Family Storytime/ Hora de Cuentos & Stay and Play

entries.description: Participating in the Reading to Children program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading and learning.nbsp;Children will enjoy one-on-one or small group interaction with our volunteersnbsp;Mike, Sally Matt.nbsp;Kids are also welcome to practice reading to our volunteer.\nFree.
